title: Champollion model aliases (shared/model-aliases.json)
description: Cross-runtime SSOT mapping short convenience aliases (e.g. 'gemini-flash') to full provider-qualified model ids (e.g. 'google/gemini-3.5-flash'). Keys other than the underscore-prefixed metadata fields are alias names; their values are model ids. The bundled mini-schema validator does not support additionalProperties-as-schema, so per-entry validation iterates the entries against $defs.aliasName / $defs.modelId (see cli/test/shared-ssot-schemas.test.js).

aliasName.description: Short alias key: lowercase alphanumerics and hyphens.
